specs.title: Card owns spacing and parts independently of nested cards and control density

RN-06 dark default: actual container geometry, density and independent scroll

spacing hierarchy: independent choices, equality and zero preserve live drafts and actual panel geometry

outer cards: apply all three spacings independently from panels without losing drafts
RN-06 narrow viewport: grouped actions, long validation, theme changes and forced colors remain usable
RN-06 independent consumer: prototype uses the package alongside unchanged Card and Dialog
